title: Almost perfect
body: The habit tracker app is nearly perfect for my needs, but it could be flawless if it included a feature allowing us to track specific habits - such as drinking five bottles of water a day. Currently, this isn't possible within the app. I hope the developers will incorporate this feature in the future.
